description: This file contains extension methods for configuring in-memory grain storage within the Orleans silo host builder framework. It provides methods to add memory-based storage as default or named storage providers, with optional configuration delegates.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring memory grain storage in the Orleans SiloBuilder.

methods.name: AddMemoryGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a default in-memory grain storage provider to the silo builder with specific configuration options.

methods.name: AddMemoryGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds a named in-memory grain storage provider to the silo builder with configurable options.
